```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Raleway:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="map-challenge-2026/gallery.css">

<div class="mc" id="mc">
  <header class="mc-head">
    <h1 class="mc-title">#30DayMapChallenge 2026</h1>
    <p class="mc-lede">Thirty maps of energy infrastructure, one for each day of November. Each map follows the day's prompt from the <a href="https://30daymapchallenge.com/">#30DayMapChallenge</a>.</p>

    <div class="mc-progress">
      <p class="mc-progress-label" id="mc-progress-label">Loading maps</p>
      <ol class="mc-strip" id="mc-strip" aria-hidden="true"></ol>
    </div>
  </header>

  <div class="mc-filters" id="mc-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter maps by tag" hidden></div>
  <p class="mc-status" id="mc-status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>

  <ol class="mc-grid" id="mc-grid"></ol>

  <noscript><p>This gallery needs JavaScript to load the maps.</p></noscript>

  <dialog class="mc-lb" id="mc-lb" aria-labelledby="mc-lb-title">
    <div class="mc-lb-inner">
      <figure class="mc-lb-figure">
        <img id="mc-lb-img" alt="">
      </figure>
      <div class="mc-lb-side">
        <button type="button" class="mc-lb-close" id="mc-lb-close" aria-label="Close">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 4l12 12M16 4L4 16" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
        </button>
        <p class="mc-lb-day"><span class="mc-lb-num" id="mc-lb-num"></span><span id="mc-lb-theme"></span></p>
        <h2 class="mc-lb-title" id="mc-lb-title"></h2>
        <p class="mc-lb-date" id="mc-lb-date"></p>
        <p class="mc-lb-blurb" id="mc-lb-blurb"></p>
        <ul class="mc-lb-tags" id="mc-lb-tags" aria-label="Tags"></ul>
        <div class="mc-lb-actions" id="mc-lb-actions"></div>
        <nav class="mc-lb-nav" aria-label="Browse maps">
          <button type="button" id="mc-lb-prev"><span aria-hidden="true">&larr;</span> Previous</button>
          <span class="mc-lb-pos" id="mc-lb-pos"></span>
          <button type="button" id="mc-lb-next">Next <span aria-hidden="true">&rarr;</span></button>
        </nav>
      </div>
    </div>
  </dialog>
</div>

<script src="map-challenge-2026/gallery.js" defer></script>
```
